title: Mechanism of High-Affinity KEAP1 Recruitment by USP25 via a Specialized ETGQ Motif.
authors: Ning, Xuan; Hu, Fangning; Su, Zihui; Ming, Zhenhua; Luo, Beibei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究USP25与KEAP1的蛋白-蛋白互作机制，虽非TF-DNA体系，但使用AlphaFold 3结构建模和突变分析解析结合界面，其蛋白互作建模方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The KEAP1-NRF2 axis is the main regulator of the cellular antioxidant response. Recent studies identified the deubiquitinase USP25 as a key stabilizer of KEAP1, but the molecular basis of their interaction is unclear. In this study, the result of gel filtration and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) show that the USP25 catalytic domain binds directly to the KEAP1 Kelch domain with high affinity. Using mutational analysis of the canonical Kelch binding pocket and simple sequence searching, we identify a non-canonical ETGQ motif in USP25. AlphaFold 3 structural modeling and structure-guided mutagenesis show that this ETGQ motif is required and sufficient for binding to the Kelch beta-propeller. Because of this interaction, the closely related homolog USP28 does not regulate the KEAP1-NRF2 axis. This study defines the molecular architecture of the USP25-KEAP1 interface. It also provides a clear structural framework for the rational design of protein-protein interaction inhibitors aimed at treating oxidative stress-related diseases.
abstract_zh: KEAP1-NRF2轴是细胞抗氧化反应的主要调节因子。近期研究将去泛素化酶USP25鉴定为KEAP1的关键稳定因子，但二者相互作用的分子基础尚不明确。本研究中，凝胶过滤和等温滴定量热法（ITC）的结果表明，USP25催化结构域直接与KEAP1 Kelch结构域高亲和力结合。通过对经典Kelch结合口袋的突变分析和简单序列搜索，我们在USP25中识别出一个非经典ETGQ基序。AlphaFold 3结构建模和结构引导的突变分析显示，该ETGQ基序对于与Kelchβ-螺旋桨的结合是必要且充分的。由于这种相互作用，密切相关的同源物USP28并不调节KEAP1-NRF2轴。本研究定义了USP25-KEAP1界面的分子结构，并为合理设计旨在治疗氧化应激相关疾病的蛋白-蛋白相互作用抑制剂提供了清晰的结构框架。
